crossRefs.note: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…
Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.
Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who…
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…

translations.web: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
translations.bsb: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
translations.kjv: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
translations.asv: He stirreth up the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.
